critical_code_review_comments: isHdr regex /^\[.+\]$/ correctly treats '[Hook] Line C' as a lyric and pure-tag lines as headers.
stamp() uses nextLine() which advances over header lines, guaranteeing tag lines are never stamped.
Space handler blurs the active button + uses !e.repeat to prevent burst stamping or play/pause toggling.
pointerdown handler is the sole stamp path for mouse; click handler ignores stamp when e.detail>0 to avoid double-firing, while keyboard-triggered click (detail==0) still works.
Cross-origin fetch errors for https://treesh.app/content/whatsnew.json and /content/blog fail silently in preview (expected per mocked setup) — no app-level impact.
